Event.Title: Harvest Hop
Event.Description: The Harvest Hop is our 50's themed social dance for the fall semester! We will have swing instruction provided by club officers mixed with open social dance to 50s music.

Event.Title: Care Week Workshop
Event.Description: A dance workshop for care week.

Event.Title: Clubs Night!
Event.Description: Clubs Night takes place every Tuesday during the Fall and Winter semesters from 7:00–10:00 PM in the Wilkinson Student Center. With two sessions (7:00–8:30 PM and 8:30–10:00 PM), students can stop by, experience club activities, meet officers, and discover new ways to get involved on campus.
